explicitLimits: The manual is a source-reviewed player guide, not a native full-mod release certificate.
Source coverage is topic/chapter based; no claim that every line of code or authored scenario is separately described.
The existing technical guide is retained untouched because it has unrelated active economy edits.
Only hardware requirements retain necessary numeric planning information. Gameplay tuning percentages and formulas are intentionally omitted.
A representative typical RAM range, peak-memory benchmark and clean-machine Reign minimum specification are not established.
Remaining approved-reference pictures are temporary layout examples. User-supplied in-game captures establish visible presentation only; they do not certify a complete feature lifecycle.
No gameplay providers, native campaign changes, game launches, deployment, commits or publication are performed for manual production. External editorial consultations are separately authorized.

The November 9 additions distinguish deployed behavior from the NPC Clan Trade candidate. Marriage native evidence covers a single Aserai route. The action reference accounts for all conversation catalog IDs, including conditional and legacy entries, without claiming every route has native acceptance.
